epics.description: Nhóm mục tiêu xây lớp Harness và CLI bền vững để lưu intake, story, proof, trace và backlog cho agent/human workflow.

epics.name: E02 - Nền tảng multisite giai đoạn 1
epics.description: Nhóm mục tiêu dựng nền CMS đa site, site settings, phân quyền, console quản trị, review site, go-live review và migration gate.

epics.name: E03 - SEO, metadata và theme nền tảng

epics.name: E05 - Quản trị theme và hero trong CMS

epics.name: E06 - Thư viện layout preset
epics.description: Nhóm mục tiêu xây thư viện layout preset code-owned cho Page Wizard và Page Composer.

epics.name: E07 - Nền tảng sản phẩm tour WingsGo
epics.description: Nhóm mục tiêu xây structured tour product model, tour detail builder, departure variants, UX lịch khởi hành và tài liệu import mapping.

epics.name: E08 - Nâng cấp inbound WingSide
epics.description: Nhóm mục tiêu nâng cấp WingSide inbound về giao diện, hero/search, motion, page composer, locale, navigation, content và readiness proof.

Typed Payload hi-fi contract, validated route model, governed Plan/Contact form ownership, scoped chrome and eight hub compositions are live. Exactly 40 page-locale entries were applied and verified; production passed 8/8 hub smoke, 54/54 responsive checks, Plan/Contact one-form contracts, SEO/security probes and tenant isolation.

US-047.proofStatusNote: Merged and production-released on 2026-07-24 at application release commit 0cc90d9276c5256e572af37ba223bfa357ae4b15; later documentation-only master commits do not change the active runtime. PostgreSQL migration and restore-drilled encrypted backup passed. The idempotent production import created 24 Media records and five localized blocks with 120 placements (105 verified, 15 needs-review); repeated apply wrote zero rows. Public desktop/mobile QA exposes exactly 21 verified awards per locale, all 21 images return HTTP 200, and next/previous navigation passes. Authenticated production Admin QA passed on Published Page 142 with 24 rows, 24 Media relations and the complete governed field contract in en, vi, it, es and pt; the read-only audit made no content change, invoked neither Save nor Publish, and produced no browser errors or warnings. The unauthenticated Page API still exposes metadata for the three needs-review items; suppression is renderer-only and API hardening is a tracked follow-up.
